target.title: fix: 429 errors without rate-limit wording skip the same-model retry
target.body:
Closes #99096

> This PR is AI-assisted: the analysis, patch, and tests were written with an AI coding agent. A human operator reviewed the change and validated it against a live deployment.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where agent turns routed through aggregated providers (for example OpenRouter provider pools) fail immediately on transient throttles. The provider surfaces `429 Provider returned error` with no RPM/TPM wording and no Retry-After header, the short-window gate rejects that shape, and the existing same-model rate-limit retry never fires. On deployments that pin providers with `allow_fallbacks: false`, every such 429 becomes a hard user-visible turn failure even though an immediate retry on the same pin almost always succeeds.

## Why This Change Was Made

`resolveShortWindowRateLimitRetry` required short-window wording or a Retry-After of 60s or less before allowing the same-model retry. This change additionally accepts errors whose message begins with HTTP status 429, reusing the existing `extractLeadingHttpStatus` helper, and only after the long-window guard has filtered quota, usage, and billing phrasings. Retry pacing is unchanged: with no Retry-After present the default backoff ladder applies. Non-429 statuses, mid-string "(429)" forms, and wording-only messages ("rate limit exceeded" without a status) keep their current behavior.

## User Impact

Operators using aggregated providers get automatic same-model retries for transient bare 429s instead of failed turns, with no configuration change. Behavior is unchanged for quota or billing 429s, long Retry-After values, and errors that already matched the short-window wording.

## Evidence

- Targeted suite: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-embedded-agent.config.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/assistant-failover.test.ts` passes 30/30, including 4 new tests (retry fires for `429 Provider returned error`; a quota-worded 429 still rotates profiles instead of retrying; `isShortWindowRateLimitMessage` accepts the bare-429 shape and still rejects long-window and wording-only messages).
- Red/green check: with the source change stashed, exactly the 2 new behavioral tests fail and the remaining 28 pass; with the change applied, all 30 pass.
- Live observation motivating the fix: on a 2026.6.10 multi-agent gateway with an OpenRouter-pinned provider pool, `embedded_run_failover_decision` events show `rawErrorPreview: '429 Provider returned error'`, `providerRuntimeFailureKind: 'rate_limit'`, and zero same-model retries fired before the error surfaced.
- Full `pnpm build` / `pnpm check` were not run to completion locally (memory-constrained shared host); relying on CI for the full gate.
